scope: Temple, Texas; current sales, service and model-research pages were reviewed.

observations.title: Keep seasonal hours consistent
observations.observed: The live service-page footer says Saturdays are closed for winter beginning October 3. The embedded booking policy still lists Saturday hours of 8 a.m.–1 p.m.
observations.improvement: Reconcile the booking policy with current winter hours, including any appointment messages. State effective dates for a clear drop-off schedule.

observations.title: Separate available stock from model research
observations.observed: The Brands page presents manufacturer catalogs with New Models links and some separate In-Stock links; the homepage also offers an in-stock inventory path.
observations.improvement: Test two clear choices: available boats or model research. Keep the distinction visible on phones and retain the selected brand when switching.

sources.label: Boat service / hours and booking policy

limitations: The embedded scheduler was inspected after loading; no appointment was submitted. The hours discrepancy reflects the snapshot date.
Public website review only. No forms submitted or mobile-usability, conversion, speed or internal-system tests performed.
